description: Liberia electricity transmission network 2023 is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Transmission and distribution", published or maintained by Fang Fang, Laurens Hagendoorn, Fiona Gallagher, Geert Koster, Anders Pedersen, Clara Ivanescu, Parth Khare (NEO). This dataset gives a full overview of the current (up to 2022) transmission grid infrastructure of Liberia including power plants, power stations, power towers and power lines with attributes such as length, assumed voltage level etc.. Coverage: Liberia. It has 1 file in SHP ZIP. The portal files it under Energy access, Transmission and distribution. The portal gives 2023 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
